title: Free AI for pixelated spritesheet
author: rushaydotexe
selftext: I just started making a detective game but I have terrible art skills so does anyone know a free AI where I can generate spritesheets for simple animations like walking?? Help would be appreciated

comments.author: op_app_pewer
comments.body:
Free is hard since the local video generators are not good enough yet

Something like dreamforge.ai is good value for money though (you can probably create characters and props for a couple of different games for 20$

Uses the best image and video models for the job (and doesn’t waste money on nano banana pro which is expensive and not great for this)

replies.author: invertednz
replies.body: I looked at this and it wasn't good. I thought others were better.

replies.author: op_app_pewer
replies.body:
Interesting! What did others do better, and what was lacking in dreamforge?

Since it is closed beta and it doesn’t show how the animations work I am surprised you have an opinion on it^^

replies.author: invertednz
replies.body:
There have been a number of posts about it and I've played one of the games, assuming the games are the same as the sprites generated I think the standalone sprite gen tools are better.

i.e. - [https://dreamforge.ai/play/0a25d9-create-a-complete-vampire-survivors-style-arena-](https://dreamforge.ai/play/0a25d9-create-a-complete-vampire-survivors-style-arena-)

replies.author: op_app_pewer
replies.body:
Cool
Makes sense, thanks!

That’s just one game I generated via 5 prompts though :D

If you have some particular art style you think would over people such as yourself, please suggest and I can see if any early user can do something with it ^^

replies.author: rushaydotexe
replies.body: Sure man , I'll give it a try !

replies.author: rushaydotexe
replies.body: I tried it but it didn't give optimal results

comments.author: RelapseCatAddict
comments.body:
[https://www.pixellab.ai/](https://www.pixellab.ai/) Can probbaly help you out with your walk animations. They recently released their Animate with Text option to help you out. 

However free spreetsheet gen is kinda hard to come back. Most AI genrated software uses credits and those credits cost money. So if you got like 30-50 to spare for a service then you're good to go.

replies.author: rushaydotexe
replies.body: Will try it man. Thanks for your help!

comments.author: beelllllll
comments.body: I made https://www.autosprite.io/ for this exact reason. It has walk and many other animation presets. The free tier can get you started and you can make walk and a few others including custom quickly

comments.author: WubsGames
comments.body:
Ai image generation is pretty terrible at pixel art still, with some of the best results coming out of a model called "Retro Diffusion" which you can indeed run locally.

I wouldn't expect much from AI animations yet, especially for pixel art.

You might have better luck with some of the free asset packs on sites like [itch.io](http://itch.io) or the Unity asset store.

replies.author: rushaydotexe
replies.body:
Yes , pixel art should be wayy easy for algorithm to understand and for AI to generate but I never get optimal results.

Also , I checked itch.io but it's really hard to find consistent resources as ppl have different art styles and free only gives like demo or smthfor most .

comments.author: Chriolant
comments.body: Nano Banana Pro can produce spritesheets. Needs some prompting on the size of each sprite though

replies.author: rushaydotexe
replies.body: Will check , thanks for your help!
